products.title: GoldPlus GP-C08 12W USB Fast Charger, 2A (UK plug)
products.longDescription: A compact 12W wall charger with a single USB-A port and a UK 3-pin plug. Charges at up to 2A (5V) and supports 9V/1A fast charging for phones that accept it. Works with iPhone, Android and other USB-powered devices. ABS body with circuit protection and an explosion-proof resistor. Every unit is tested before it is sold; same-day delivery in Kampala and Wakiso.
